stances.summary: Advocates for civil left-right debates on social media
stances.quote:
I hope that Twitter becomes a place for civil debates between people on the left and the right.

Many folks will mock this idea. But I refuse to accept cynicism. I think social media, when done well, can be a great place for high-quality, entertaining, good-faith debates.

stances.summary: Praises transparency for fighting corruption and political bias
stances.quote:
Twitter Files release is most beneficial to humanity not because of what it revealed, but because it promotes a culture of transparency.

Transparency is good for everyone long-term. It helps fight corruption and influence of ideological and political bias, left or right.

stances.summary: Calls Twitter Files release historic and democracy-strengthening
stances.quote: The Twitter Files release is historic. This will strengthen our democracy.

stances.summary: Endorses Elon's Twitter acquisition as beneficial for free speech
stances.quote: Elon buying Twitter is good for the world.

stances.summary: Frames Musk's Twitter acquisition as victory for free speech
stances.quote: Elon Musk acquiring Twitter is a big win for free speech.

stances.summary: Defends Joe Rogan against censorship pressure, criticizes media division-mongering
stances.quote:
I stand with Joe Rogan. It is not a coincidence that the attacks calling him racist come as pressure on Spotify to censor builds.

Politicians and the media profit on division & outrage. They fuel the extremes that make us believe we're divided. We're not. We're in this toget

stances.summary: Opposes White House pressure on Spotify to censor Joe Rogan
stances.quote: The White House pressuring Spotify to censor Joe Rogan is un-American. We are better than this.

stances.summary: Praises Spotify for resisting censorship pressure
stances.quote: Spotify not caving under pressure to censor is admirable and important.

stances.summary: Defends Elon Musk against Nazi comparisons
stances.quote: Elon Musk is not a Nazi. Y'all lost your minds 🤣

stances.summary: Rejects woke culture and virtue signaling, advocates kindness
stances.quote:
Wokeism is dead.

No more virtue signaling with pronouns, etc please.

Just be kind to people.

stances.summary: Praises America as greatest nation, celebrates democratic argument
stances.quote:
Happy Birthday America! To me, the greatest nation on Earth. 250 years of loudly arguing our way toward a more perfect union 😂 We're in this together, I love you all! ❤️

PS: World Cup has been amazing. US in the round of 16, LFG! Also, I'm a long-time huge fan of Argentina and M

stances.summary: Advocates for transparent and efficient government
stances.quote: Everyone should be in favor of transparent, efficient government. Seems obvious.

stances.summary: Seeks Trump podcast interview to inform platform reinstatement decision
stances.quote: I'd like to talk to Trump on podcast. Make it a tough, raw, honest conversation. Maybe it'll help Twitter decide if to bring him back.

stances.summary: Seeks direct interviews with Putin and Zelenskyy to promote peace
stances.quote:
I hope to interview both Zelenskyy and Putin, likely in January.

For this, I will travel to both Kyiv and Moscow.

My hope is to do my small part to understand their perspectives & to find the path to peace.

I understand the risks.

PS: I speak fluent Russian & some Ukr

stances.summary: Expresses solidarity with Iranian people seeking freedom
stances.quote: I send my love to the Iranian people who are standing up for their freedom.

stances.summary: Opposes war hawks in government positions
stances.quote: Keep warmongers out of government.

stances.summary: Commits to documenting Ukraine and Russia, plans Putin interview
stances.quote:
I stayed up all night talking to people in Ukraine and Russia.

I'll publish Mark Zuckerberg podcast another today.

I will travel to Russia and Ukraine. I will speak to citizens and leaders, including Putin.

War is pain. My words are useless. I send my love, it's all I have.

stances.summary: Predicts Trump landslide victory, endorses long-form political podcasts
stances.quote:
Looks like Trump is going to win, potential landslide. Leading in every swing state.

Let that sink in.

PS: Long-form podcasts FTW. I hope to see politicians from both sides doing 2-3+ hour genuine, human conversations moving forward.

stances.summary: Hopes for decisive election outcome to reduce polarization
stances.quote:
I hope this election is not a close one, for everyone's sake.

Go vote.

stances.summary: Praises SpaceX's expansion of human presence in space
stances.quote:
SpaceX will help expand humanity out to the stars. It makes me excited for the future!

Huge congrats to Elon and the SpaceX team 👊

stances.summary: Celebrates human lunar mission achievement and space exploration progress
stances.quote: Humans just launched into space, on their way to the moon (flyby around it). It'll be farthest humans have ever traveled into deep space 🤯 Congrats to all the incredible engineers & teams involved! LFG!!!!!!!

stances.summary: Demands full transparency and public release of Epstein list
stances.quote:
US government needs to release the Epstein list, and be fully transparent about everything related to this case.

And don't treat the public like we're idiots. Otherwise trust is completely shattered.

It's obvious. Do the right thing.

stances.summary: Criticizes politicization of science and engineering
stances.quote:
Scientific American editor-in-chief is an embarrassment to science.

Get politics out of science, engineering, STEM education.

Science and engineering is about building cool shit, and exploring the mysteries of physics, chemistry, biology, etc.

stances.summary: Promotes long-form podcasts over legacy media, criticizes left-wing leaders' reluctance
stances.quote:
Legacy media is done.

I'd love to see presidential candidates and political leaders of both parties regularly doing long-form podcasts moving forward.

PS: I tried hard to get Kamala and other left-wing leaders on. Bernie was the only one who was game to do it. I'll keep trying.

stances.summary: Frames AI revolution as transformative economic force
stances.quote: Jensen Huang: NVIDIA - The $4 Trillion Company & the AI Revolution | Lex Fridman Podcast #494
